positions.title: Senior Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work in an Agile team to help develop and troubleshoot various AngularJS/webpack applications for the Energy industry. I also spend a good amount of time helping develop the backend in JAVA. 

All applications are energy consumption driven. They are analytic platforms for Utility companies, building owners, and Utility customers.

positions.title: Software Developer - Interoperability
positions.description:
Develop HL7, IHE, XML, and Web service interfaces (RESTful API's and URI Endpoints). Adhere to communication protocols, such as, TCP/IP, SSL/TSL, HTTP, and FTP etc. Along with interface work, develope UI components for client front-end experiences. Maintain Multi-platform, integrated systems with various forms of interfaces and integration points.

Lead developer in FHIR integration. Developed FHIR server with Node.js, Express.js, MSSQL, and Mongodb.
